target.statement: AnyCharV achieves FVD 622.01 on the 200-video evaluation set, the best FVD among compared methods in Table 1.
target.dataset: CharVG evaluation set (20 character images × 10 target driving videos; 200 generated videos)

compute.basis: The paper reports four training stages totaling tens of thousands of steps on 8 NVIDIA H800 GPUs for about 3 days, and even inference takes 5 minutes per 5-second video on an H800; CharVG and the evaluation media are not released as downloadable data.

blockers: No public code release for AnyCharV
CharVG dataset and the 20/10 evaluation media are not released
Training requires 8 NVIDIA H800 GPUs for about 3 days
Inference alone takes 5 minutes per 5-second 24 FPS video on an H800
Evaluating FVD requires 200 generated videos plus 1,000 real CharVG videos
title: AnyCharV: Bootstrap Controllable Character Video Generation with Fine-to-Coarse Guidance
